sloka: स विह्वलितसर्वाङ्गो वातोद्धूत इव द्रुमः।लाक्षारससवर्णं च सुस्राव रुधिरं मुखात् ।। ६.७०.१६ ।।
transliteration: sa vihvalitasarvāṅgo vātoddhūta iva drumaḥ।lākṣārasasavarṇaṁ ca susrāva rudhiraṁ mukhāt ।। 6.70.16 ।।

translations.english: That astonishing Rakshasa shaken like a tree, thrown by the wind, shed huge amounts of blood which was of the colour of lacquer.
